control_objective: All required sub-certifiers complete and sign their quarterly sub-certifications on time, providing the documented basis on which the CEO and CFO rely to make the §302 disclosure certification.
risk_addressed: Missing or overdue sub-certifications undermine the support for the §302 certification, increasing the risk that a material weakness or disclosure deficiency goes unreported by the certifying officers.

required_data_elements.business_definition: A sub-certification questionnaire assigned to a required sub-certifier for the period.
The completed and signed sub-certification submitted by the sub-certifier.

method.summary: Confirm that every required sub-certifier in the population has submitted a signed sub-certification on time, with no outstanding or overdue items, supporting the §302 certification.
steps: Determine the required sub-certifier population for the period from the workflow system.
Confirm receipt of a signed sub-certification for each required sub-certifier.
Identify any sub-certifications that are outstanding or past their due date.
Compute received percentage and overdue count.
Confirm disclosure committee review of sub-certification results.
method.fallback_logic: If either the workflow source or the signed-certification repository is unavailable, mark Not Run and raise a Missing Source item rather than passing.

thresholds.materiality_basis: Any required sub-certification not received, or received late, is a control exception.
thresholds.escalation_threshold: Any sub-certification not received or overdue

fail_criteria: One or more required sub-certifications are not received.
One or more sub-certifications are overdue.
exception_handling: Escalate outstanding sub-certifications to the disclosure committee before §302 certification.

downstream_linkage.staleness_rule: Must be re-evidenced each quarter before §302 certification.
